metadata.case_name: Mongolia (democratic transition + resource dependence, mixed Safeguard E)
metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: MIXED Safeguard E -- the case that sits between Botswana (positive pole) and Venezuela (negative pole). Heavy mineral dependence (mining ~20-25% of GDP; minerals ~80-90% of exports) with only moderate institutions (pre-P1 0.502), but GENUINELY democratic. Democratic accountability should partially offset resource dependence -> boom-bust volatility but NO authoritarian/rentier reversion.
metadata.notes: Reference-based record (country_ref + years; no embedded indicators). Resolved scores are real MI v2 re-scores. 1990 democratization -> 2024; scored ~1996 vs 2024. Mongolia stayed Tier 3 throughout; the near-flat MI conceals real macro volatility (the 2016-17 debt crisis / IMF program) that the framework predicts as boom-bust rather than collapse.

pre_event.event_description: Six years after the peaceful 1990 democratic transition, Mongolia was a consolidating multiparty democracy (Freedom House 'Free') whose economy was becoming heavily dependent on mineral extraction, with moderate state institutions.

Mongolia.notes: Inputs resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year). WGI 2025-anchored 0-100. Heavy mineral dependence (mining ~20-25% of GDP; minerals ~80-90% of exports) above the resource-curse threshold, but with only moderate institutions and genuine democratic competition -- the MIXED-pole test of Safeguard E.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Stable-but-volatile consolidation; Tier 3 maintained. Democratic P1 partially offsets resource dependence -> boom-bust macro volatility but no authoritarian/rentier reversion
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Moderate P1 (0.502) + Safeguard E mixed pole (above-threshold rents, moderate institutions, genuine democracy)
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Either authoritarian/rentier capture (the Venezuela path) OR Botswana-grade smooth high-growth stability -- i.e. a clean positive or negative pole rather than the predicted middle

b_violence.prediction: Low-to-moderate internal-violence RISK; episodic unrest possible, no breakdown
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY
b_violence.falsification_condition: Large-scale internal violence or state breakdown

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Residual exposure = economic volatility / commodity dependence (P4), not authoritarian capture of institutions
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure driven by authoritarian institutional capture rather than commodity-cycle volatility

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Moderate reversal risk (resource dependence + moderate institutions) but democratic accountability holds -> NO authoritarian reversion
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: Authoritarian reversion / rentier capture of the democratic system

Mongolia.outcome_summary: Stable-but-volatile as predicted (Tier 3 held): MI 0.585 -> 0.563, P1 0.502 -> 0.464. Commodity-cycle boom-bust including a 2016-17 balance-of-payments crisis and IMF program, plus episodic corruption protests (2022) -- yet democracy held throughout (Freedom House 'Free', repeated peaceful turnovers, no authoritarian/rentier reversion).

a_trajectory.evidence: Tier 3 held (MI 0.585 -> 0.563; P1 0.502 -> 0.464); commodity boom-bust (2016-17 IMF program) without authoritarian/rentier reversion
a_trajectory.explanation: The mixed-pole prediction was realized: volatility but no collapse and no capture -- the middle ground between Botswana and Venezuela, with democratic accountability doing the offsetting work.

b_violence.evidence: No large-scale internal violence; 2022 protests contained within democratic channels

analysis.overall_assessment: Confirms the mixed Safeguard E pole: heavy resource dependence under moderate institutions but genuine democracy produced boom-bust volatility without authoritarian reversion -- the predicted middle ground between Botswana's smooth success and Venezuela's capture-driven collapse.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: The Safeguard E calibration's interior point: with the rent intensity held high, varying institutions+accountability traces a continuum -- Venezuela (low P1, captured) -> Mongolia (moderate P1, democratic, volatile) -> Botswana (high P1, smooth). Democratic accountability, not rent level, is what converts dependence into mere volatility rather than reversion.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; supplies the interior calibration point for the bidirectional Safeguard E (with cases 22, 38, 42).
